Title: Yoruba Shrine + Remnant of the Elder Storm + NRA

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Does the action cancelation of Yoruba give or not give NRA taint?
It says make the action fail, and it also says as the action is announced, thus I think no NRA taint should apply

Yoruba Shrine
Type: Master
Requires: Assamite
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location.
When a ready Assamite you control is the target of a  action or is selected by the acting Methuselah in the terms of a referendum, you may tap this location to untap the acting minion and make the action or referendum fail. Only usable as the  action is announced or before any votes are cast in the referendum. Not usable on a referendum that is passing automatically.

Remnant of the Endless Storm
Type: Ally
Requires: magaji
Cost: 6 pool
Unique werewolf with 5 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed. Requires a magaji.
The Remnant gets +1 strength for each life it has. The Remnant may enter combat with any minion as a  action. If any effect does more than 2 damage to the Remnant, ignore the excess. If the Remnant has 4 or fewer life during your untap phase, it gains 1 life from the blood bank.

Messages.Author: Dorrinal
Messages.Body:
Answered you on JOL while you were writing this up.  Yoruba Shrine's card text states that the action fails. Therefore the action has been taken, and therefore cannot be repeated by the acting minion.

Contrast with Direct Intervention, et al. which cancel the action.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Yep, Yoruba Shrine says "fail" not "cancel" so its tainted by NRA.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
